description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/column_nonuniform_1d/rules/varcoeff_face_laplacian_lev_flux_bc with a genuinely variable interface coefficient K = 1 + z, driven by problems/heat_column_varcoeff_forced.esm (manufactured solution exp(-t) cos(pi z) with the matching forcing, zero interface fluxes). Nothing is discretely exact here, so the L2 errors at t=0.1 are the full second-order error of the interface-coefficient flux-difference stencil on the stretched column.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
